subject: Encord follow up | Annotation pains & FDA Approval challenges
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well. You met with my colleague [SENDER] at RSNA last year (hope
you are feeling better now!). At the time it sounded like you had struggled
with some bad experiences with poor annotator quality and were focusing on
FDA approval. It actually sounds like you're at the interjection where
clients typically start working with us where they are seeking FDA approval
and need to improve the efficiency and traceability of their annotations as
well as expand to new modalities and joints.

I've reached out to Sinan as you recommended but appreciate you are all
very busy. I wondered whether you'd be able to follow up with him if it
would be of interest to learn more about how Encord can help.

As a reminder, Encord is a data development platform for computer vision &
multimodal AI teams, focused on data curation, annotation, workflow
management and model evaluation. We work with the likes of Philips, Viz.ai
and Asesnus Surgical. Our partnership with NIH and the platform's necessary
audit-ability and traceability makes it ideal for FDA approval and reader
studies. We also offer a manager service for annotation where we ensure a
dedicated annotation team to maintain quality (annotators must pass your
requirements in order to be used).

Really appreciate your help!

subject: I saw your articles in Insider Sport - reaching out about your CV model work
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw the recent articles referencing [COMPANY] in Insider Sport - wanted to
specifically reach out to you guys. (You might see my LinkedIn
connect request too.)

I'm [SENDER] - the team and I work with a lot of global teams on the
pain points of leveraging Computer Vision in sports analytics, particularly
around things like dynamic classifications.

We work with many teams including Veo, Spiideo & MVP - sports video use
cases is a big focus now.

Our platform offers:

   - *Native Video Editor*: Apply and extrapolate (no need to apply to
   individual frames) as well as allowing for multi-frame object detection.
   Massively reducing annotation time.
   - *Infinite nesting & dynamic classifications*: track physical through
   frames such as walking, jogging, running and jumping.
   - *Key moment identification*: uncover unique periods and edge cases in
   matches and training data automatically.

I wanted to ask if you and the team would be up for a chat on how
Encord can potentially add value to your CV model data development?

It'd be great to understand more on your training data pipelines for your
CV work.
